query:
UPDATE tasks t SET github_repo = $1, updated_at = NOW()
             FROM projects p
             WHERE p.id = t.project_id
               AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
               AND p.team_id = ANY($3)
               AND t.short_id = $2
               AND t.github_repo IS NULL
               AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
             RETURNING t.id
